services.titre: From the first idea to the annual return
services.detail: As an accounting, audit and advisory firm, we provide accounting, tax and management support to Cameroonian small and medium businesses

creation.detail: Sole trader, LLC, single-member LLC, simplified joint stock, property company, public limited. Articles, registration, trade register, tax number and publication — we lodge the file for you.

adhesion.detail: We keep your books, file your monthly and annual returns, and check your documents before filing.

ponctuel.detail: Annual statistical and tax return, catch-up on a past year, support during an audit, business plan.

domiciliation.detail: A professional address in Douala, with mail handling and forwarding.

formations.detail: VAT, tax return pack, payroll and social contributions, cash records. In our offices or on your premises.

conseil.detail: Partner lawyers, notaries and chartered accountants, funding searches, banking support.

cga.titre: What membership changes for your business
cga.detail1: An approved centre is a body approved by the Minister of Finance, which assists its small member businesses
cga.detail2: with their management and their obligations. Its involvement heads off tax risk: the return is checked before it is filed.

abattement.detail: The base of your profit tax is halved, from your very first return.

exoneration.titre: Two years free of business licence tax
exoneration.detail: Cash flow preserved at the very moment your activity starts.

controle.detail: Our specialists verify your return before it reaches the tax office — that is what heads off an adjustment.

dialogue.detail: The tax administration provides technical support to approved centres; your file is handled within that framework.

etapes.titre: Three steps, and you follow everything online

etape1.detail: Company formation, accounting or legal service: two minutes are enough, with no account to create.

etape2.titre: An adviser takes your procedure in hand
etape2.detail: We call you back, draw up your itemised quote and open your file as soon as payment clears.

etape3.titre: You follow progress in real time
etape3.detail: Every step is visible in your workspace: documents received, filing at the one-stop shop, papers available.

t1.texte: My limited company was registered in three weeks, and I never once had to queue. The firm assembled the file, followed it through the registry, and handed me the trade register entry and taxpayer card on the same day.

t2.texte: Before joining, I found out about my deadlines the day before. Now the reminder arrives ten days ahead and my return is checked before it is filed. Two financial years, not a single penalty.

t3.texte: Two days of training and my assistant now enters the purchase invoices herself. I finally understood the 50 % allowance on profit — and I know which documents it takes to qualify.

t4.texte: When the audit came, everything was filed, dated and supported. The firm answered on my behalf: the inspection was over in a morning, with no reassessment.
